result.reasoning: This commit ("added use of try-with-resource") wrapped the ResultSet in try-with-resources blocks in getAllWithData and getValues methods, causing the ResultSet to be closed immediately after execution—even though it needed to remain open for lazy stream consumption via allWithDataStream()/valuesStream(). The fix commit reverts exactly this pattern (removing try-with-resources for the ResultSet, adding a comment explaining it "can't be try-with-resource because it is required to stay open"), directly undoing the bug introduced by a606537bf9dc.
